scope: Standalone Blade previews of changed templates with synthetic in-memory data and simulated task visibility. Shared component wrappers/icons and route helpers are substituted; existing request queries are replaced with inert collections. No Laravel bootstrap, account, application server, database or actual authorization is exercised.
